integrity: Definitions and quantifiers were reconstructed from the primary source. The crown minimum functions were classified directly, the edge-deletion argument was proved for arbitrary n, and an independent executable checker exhaustively verified the first nontrivial orders. Primary full text and semantic database searches were compared at statement level for crown, matching-deletion, one-factor, and complete-bipartite formulations.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to crown graphs with n at least 4. It does not classify arbitrary matching-deleted complete bipartite graphs. Finite verification covers only the stated small orders and algebraic stress tests; the universal result rests on the analytic proof.
title: Total Roman bondage of crown graphs
